text:
ash: customer on CF Workers got a runtime crash importing our SDK: `ReferenceError: process is not defined`. they import `import { createClient } from 'redwood'` in an ESM worker.

mira: likely bundler picked the CJS artifact. Workers have no Node globals (process, Buffer) and use globalThis.crypto.

jon: quick remediation: publish a small `dist/index.worker.mjs` that avoids Node APIs and update package.json `exports` to include a `worker` condition. example exports: `"exports": { ".": { "worker": "./dist/index.worker.mjs", "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" } }`.

mira: runtime notes: use webcrypto fallback detection and avoid Buffer. Pattern: `const webcrypto = typeof globalThis?.crypto?.subtle !== 'undefined' ? globalThis.crypto : (typeof process !== 'undefined' ? require('crypto').webcrypto : undefined);` keep require branch inside `if (typeof process !== 'undefined')` so bundlers can tree-shake it.

ash: types: TS only supports one `types` entry. We can ship `index.d.ts` and include `types-worker.d.ts` with `declare module 'redwood/worker' { export * from 'redwood'; }` so imports to `/worker` get typings.

ci-bot: CI: bundle:worker failing with `Could not resolve "crypto" in node_modules/redwood/dist/index.cjs` on recent PR. Assigning to @jon.

jon: action items: I'll open a tiny PR copying `index.mjs -> index.worker.mjs`, strip Node-only bits, update exports, and add a mini sample in `devex/samples/cloudflare/` showing `import Redwood from 'redwood/worker'`. mira will add the types augmentation and a README blurb.

mira: also recommend maintainers repro locally with `miniflare --modules` or `wrangler dev` to catch resolution issues.

ash: cool. hopefully this cuts down edge support tickets. :thumbsup:
